title: Halo newsletter
description: A big two-line heading on the left and, on the right, a small sign-up form: a tiny label, a hairline-bordered email field, a consent checkbox with fine print and a disabled-looking outlined button. Stacks on phones.
notes: the form posts to the action prop's URL; it has no JavaScript of its own
the button looks switched off until the checkbox is ticked (CSS only)
